_about: Japanese names no source gives (Champions' text, Showdown's ja data, PokeAPI): each with where it comes from and whether the user reviewed it. tools/i18n/build_names.js applies these over every source.

greninjabond.name: ゲッコウガ（きずなへんげ）
greninjabond.source: the games show Battle Bond Greninja as plain ゲッコウガ; labelled by its ability's official name (きずなへんげ) to tell it apart

pichuspikyeared.name: ギザみみピチュー
pichuspikyeared.source: official name (HGSS event); PokeAPI has no Japanese form name for it

mail.name: メール
mail.source: the generic Mail placeholder; each mail item has its own name in the games
